description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cognizant is hiring a Full Stack Software Developer to help build and maintain scalable, reactive web applications. The role contributes to full-stack development, testing, DevOps workflows, documentation, and collaboration with Agile project teams while learning modern technologies.
Full-stack web developer building Java reactive services, REST APIs, and React interfaces with automated testing

Responsibilities:
• Develop and maintain full-stack web applications using Java, Spring Reactive, and React JS
• Design and implement RESTful APIs and reactive microservices
• Build responsive, dynamic, and accessible user interfaces using React JS
• Write clean, modular, and well-documented code
• Create and maintain unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
• Participate in peer code reviews
• Debug and resolve issues across the stack
• Use Git for version control and collaborate via GitHub or GitLab
• Work with CI/CD pipelines
• Familiarity with Docker is a plus
• Explore and utilize AI-powered tools like GitHub Copilot or Cursor
• Stay updated with emerging technologies
• Participate in tech talks, workshops, and hackathons
• Work in Agile teams and participate in ceremonies
• Collaborate with designers, QA engineers, and backend developers
• Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders
• Maintain technical documentation
• Provide regular updates on progress

Requirements:
• Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field
• Candidate should possess strong Java application development skills (e.g., Core Java technologies, React JavasScript, & Spring framework)
• Demonstrated experiences in cloud computing such as Azure OpenShift and AWS, etc
• Understanding of software development methodologies
• Self-motivated individuals with strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the passion and appetite to learn newer technologies
• Excellent interpersonal & communication skills; actively participates in team meetings discussions and be a specialist in Object Oriented analysis and design using common design patterns
• Ability to work collaboratively with global project teams
• Cognizant cannot provide sponsorship for U.S. work authorization (including participation in a CPT/OPT program) for this role
